entry.note: Identified from the title page (arXiv:math/0612592v1, math.AC, single author, 16 pp; the ingestion found no section breaks, so the single library section is the whole document). No ref() entry existed; vanderput2006 created 2026-09-07 by the triage. No citation site yet; one bean queued.

relevance.rationale: A survey (proofs deferred to [P-S] and [P-R] = vanderput-reversat2007, already registered) that states in English two results the corpus already uses under other names. (i) Thm 3.4/3.5: E(cz^{t/n}) is pure, irreducible, of slope t/n, every irreducible module is one of these, and the indecomposable pure modules are E(cz^{t/n}) tensor U_m with (t/n, c^n, m) unique — the E(r,d,b) irreducibility that BindingScalarKernelParityExclusion.lean, binding-genfun-qdifference.md and qdifference-kernel-prolongation-symbol.md attribute to 'the van der Put-Reversat structure theorem'. FINDING: the Lean file points that theorem at library/crmath-2011-349-19-20-1037-0/, which is Bugeaud 2011 (bugeaud2011), not van der Put-Reversat (library/afst-2007-6-16-3-665-0/); no bean tracked the mis-pointer before this triage. (ii) §5: the difference Galois groups case by case — (1) regular singular Gal(M) = Hom(L, C*) times G_a when A is not semisimple, (5) 1 -> U_xi -> Gal(M) -> Gal(gr M) -> 1 with U_xi unipotent and the sequence a semi-direct product; Remarks 5.1: Gal(M)^o is solvable, and the computation is algorithmic given the global lattice. That is the torus-extended-by-unipotent shape QAlienBridgeEquation.lean calls 'the Levi decomposition of the local q-difference Galois group' with only RSZ as its source. Also read: Thm 3.2 (slope filtration), Thm 3.8 (split modules -> vector bundles on E_q), Thm 4.1 (moduli), §6 and Thm 6.3 (universal Picard-Vessiot ring, generators f_{m,c,mu} algebraically independent). Not core: nothing in it is used that vanderput-reversat2007 does not also carry; its value is the English statement and the correct pointer. 'van der Put' greps: 5 content files (references.ts, the two .md blocks, the Lean file, the ledger), 1 audit (branch-selection-birkhoff-connection-matrix, which cites the AFST paper correctly).

keyResults.statement: E(cz^{t/n}) is pure, irreducible, of slope t/n; every irreducible module over C({z}) is of this form; the indecomposable pure modules are E(cz^{t/n}) tensor U_m with (t/n, c^n, m) unique.
keyResults.useForFolio: The E(r,d,b) irreducibility the parity-exclusion argument corroborates itself with, stated in English; fixes the mis-pointer at library/crmath-2011 (Bugeaud) in BindingScalarKernelParityExclusion.lean.

keyResults.statement: Regular singular: Gal(M) = Hom(L, C*) (times G_a if A is not semisimple). General: 1 -> U_xi -> Gal(M) -> Gal(gr M) -> 1, U_xi unipotent, a semi-direct product; Gal(M)^o is solvable.
keyResults.useForFolio: The literature statement of the Levi-decomposition shape (torus of characters extended by a unipotent part) that QAlienBridgeEquation.lean asserts in its docstring.
